title.en: TalkCV — AI-Native Interactive Résumé & Portfolio Engine
title.zh: TalkCV — AI 原生交互式简历与作品集引擎

role.zh: 独立开发者 · 全栈架构

summary.en: Turns any PDF/DOCX/image résumé into a bilingual interactive website with dual rendering modes (structured deep skins + custom AI web mode), cited visitor AI Q&A, JD match scoring, private AI brief boundaries, QR A4 PDF export, and passcode privacy.
summary.zh: 支持 PDF/DOCX/截图一键解析，提供结构化深度皮肤与自由创意网页双渲染模式，内置带引用的访客 AI 问答、JD 匹配报告、私密 AI 回答边界、带二维码 A4 打印简历与口令保护。

outcome.en: Shipped end-to-end with dual render engines, 6+ visual presets, and edge-lightweight architecture.
outcome.zh: 独立完成从解析、双渲染引擎、6+ 视觉皮肤到支付与边缘部署的完整闭环。

title.en: Grounded AI Q&A with Verifiable Inline Citations
title.zh: 严格基于事实的内联引用 AI 问答

body.en: Every visitor answer is grounded in the structured résumé schema plus owner-only private AI brief boundaries, emitting clickable citation markers that scroll directly to the matching project or experience card.
body.zh: 访客对话严格绑定结构化简历与仅作者可见的私有 AI 回答边界，回复自动附带可点击引用标记，点击直接定位到对应项目或经历。

title.zh: 解析与结构化

text.en: Extracts text from PDF, DOCX, or résumé screenshots with strict numerical fidelity.
text.zh: 从 PDF、Word 或简历截图无损提取事实与量化指标，拒绝模型幻觉。

title.zh: 双模式渲染与发布

text.en: Switches seamlessly between editable deep-skin layouts and sandboxed custom AI web pages.
text.zh: 支持在可编辑深度皮肤与沙箱自由创意网页间自由切换，并一键导出带码 A4 PDF。

category.zh: 企业级 Agent 协同应用

title.zh: 企业级 Agent 协同电子表格系统

summary.en: Architected a unified spreadsheet DSL with sharded on-demand loading, 7 incremental patch save operations, and human-AI concurrency execution locks, fully preserving cross-sheet formulas and XLSX import/export.
summary.zh: 设计统一表格 DSL 与分片按需加载机制，实现 7 类增量补丁保存与人机并发运行锁，完整兼容跨 Sheet 公式与 XLSX 双向导入导出。

outcome.en: Cut initial save upload payload by 46%, passed 107 targeted unit tests, and completed SaaS migration in 16 days.
outcome.zh: 首次保存上传体积降低 46%，通过 107 项定向单测，16 天完成 SaaS 迁移交付。

title.en: Sharded Incremental Patches & Human-AI Concurrency Locks
title.zh: 分片增量补丁与人机并发保护

body.en: Replaced full-workbook overwrites with 7 deterministic patch types and optimistic concurrency guards so users and 18 specialized Agent tools can operate safely on large workbooks.
body.zh: 用 7 类确定性增量补丁替代整表覆盖保存，配合人机并发锁与 18 个专属 Agent 工具，确保多人与 Agent 协同不丢数据。

title.zh: 统一 DSL 与分片加载

text.en: Splits large workbooks by sheet/region for fast initial render and 46% smaller save payloads.
text.zh: 按 Sheet 与区域分片加载，显著降低首屏与首次保存传输体积（-46%）。

title.zh: 18 工具安全执行

text.en: Locks active mutations during Agent runs while keeping cross-sheet formulas and XLSX fidelity intact.
text.zh: 在 Agent 执行期间加锁保护，完整保留跨表公式与 XLSX 兼容性。

category.zh: 多模态 AI 工作流引擎

title.zh: 高可靠多模态 AI Workflow 调度引擎

summary.en: Built the end-to-end async streaming pipeline (API → ARQ enqueue → Worker event dispatch → Redis Stream → SSE), extended mixed image/video/document multimodal inputs, and serialized multi-instance DB migrations with MySQL named locks.
summary.zh: 打通 API → ARQ 入队 → Worker 事件调度 → Redis Stream → SSE 全链路异步流式执行，扩展图片/视频/文档混合多模态输入，并基于 MySQL 命名锁实现多实例数据库迁移并发保护。

outcome.en: Supports up to 10 multimodal attachments per run, passed 30/30 production large-data regressions and 10 real concurrent migration tests.
outcome.zh: 支持单次最多 10 个多模态附件，通过 30/30 生产大数据回归测试与 10 路真实并发迁移验证。

title.zh: 解耦流式调度与多实例迁移锁

body.en: Decoupled long-running multimodal nodes from HTTP workers via ARQ and Redis Streams with ordered SSE delivery, and eliminated startup race conditions across horizontal replicas with MySQL GET_LOCK.
body.zh: 通过 ARQ 与 Redis Stream 将耗时多模态节点与 HTTP 进程彻底解耦，并利用 MySQL 命名锁消除多副本启动迁移竞态。

title.zh: 异步入队与多模态输入

text.en: Accepts up to 10 mixed image/video/document attachments and dispatches to ARQ workers.
text.zh: 支持单次最多 10 个图片/视频/文档混合附件并交由 ARQ Worker 异步执行。

title.zh: Redis Stream → SSE 流式推送

text.en: Streams node events reliably to clients with reconnect safety and verified production regressions.
text.zh: 通过 Redis Stream 向客户端稳定推送节点事件，通过 30/30 生产级大数据回归验证。

category.zh: 开源开发者工具与自动化

title.en: Cross-Platform AI DevTools & Content Distribution Kit
title.zh: 跨平台 AI 开发者工具与多平台内容分发套件

summary.en: Open-source tooling spanning a macOS/Windows Chinese localization patch for Claude Desktop (3 Chinese locale variants) and an idempotent Postiz + multimodal video social distribution pipeline with mandatory human approval gates.
summary.zh: 涵盖 macOS/Windows 双端 Claude Desktop 本地化补丁（覆盖 3 种中文区域变体），以及带 100% 人工审批闸门的 Postiz + 多模态视频海外社媒幂等排期流水线。

outcome.en: Covers 2 desktop OS platforms, 3 Chinese locale variants, and 100% human-in-the-loop publishing safeguards.
outcome.zh: 覆盖 2 大桌面操作系统与 3 种中文变体，实现 100% 人工审批防误发闸门。

title.en: Idempotent Pipelines with Mandatory Approval Gates
title.zh: 幂等流水线与人工审批闸门

body.en: Designed repeatable asset generation and social scheduling workflows where every external post passes an explicit human sign-off checkpoint to guarantee zero accidental publishes.
body.zh: 将多模态素材生产与海外社媒排期做成可重试的幂等流水线，每条对外内容必须经过显式人工确认闸门，杜绝误发。

title.zh: 双端桌面补丁

text.en: Supports macOS and Windows Electron bundles across Simplified & Traditional Chinese locales.
text.zh: 兼容 macOS 与 Windows 双端桌面应用，覆盖 3 种中文区域变体。

title.zh: 人工审批分发

text.en: Generates drafts and schedules to Postiz only after 100% explicit human approval.
text.zh: 生成素材与排期草稿，经 100% 显式人工审批后自动同步至发布队列。
